title: A place I know
prompt: Elige la oración escrita en presente perfecto.
options: I have visited Santa Ana twice.
I visited Santa Ana yesterday.
I am visiting Santa Ana now.
answer: I have visited Santa Ana twice.
hint: Busca have + participio pasado.
explanation: Have visited expresa una experiencia pasada relacionada con el presente.

title: A letter from the past
prompt: Completa con el participio de write: I have ___ a letter to a friend.
hint: Write es irregular: write, wrote, ...
explanation: Written es el participio pasado de write.

title: The match
prompt: Completa con el participio de play: We have ___ volleyball together.
hint: Play es regular: agrega -ed.
explanation: Played es un participio regular.

title: A new friend
prompt: Elige la palabra correcta: She ___ met a new friend this year.
options: have
has
had
hint: Con she se usa el auxiliar singular.
explanation: She has met lleva has + el participio irregular met.

title: A surprising view
prompt: Completa con el participio de see: I have ___ the ocean for the first time.
hint: See es irregular: see, saw, ...
explanation: Seen es el participio pasado de see.

title: The question card
prompt: Elige la pregunta correcta para hablar de experiencias de vida.
options: Have you ever climbed a mountain?
Did you ever climbed a mountain?
Has you ever climb a mountain?
answer: Have you ever climbed a mountain?
hint: Comienza con Have you ever y termina con un participio.
explanation: Ever pregunta si una experiencia ha ocurrido alguna vez.

title: The trip
prompt: Completa con el participio de go: They have ___ to the museum.
hint: Go es irregular: go, went, ...
explanation: Gone es el participio pasado de go.

title: The unopened door
prompt: Elige la palabra correcta: I have ___ tried surfing, but I would like to.
options: never
ever
already
hint: La persona dice que esa experiencia no le ha ocurrido.
explanation: Never indica que la experiencia no ha sucedido nunca.

title: A school memory
prompt: Completa con el participio de study: We have ___ English together this year.
hint: Cuando hay consonante + y, cambia la y por i y agrega -ed.
explanation: Studied es el participio regular de study.

title: Not yet
prompt: Elige la oración correcta.
options: She has not tried sushi yet.
She have not try sushi yet.
She has not tried sushi yesterday.
answer: She has not tried sushi yet.
hint: Usa has + participio; yet suele ir al final.
explanation: Yet expresa que la experiencia no ha ocurrido hasta ahora.

title: A memorable meal
prompt: Completa con el participio de eat: I have ___ a new dish.
hint: Eat es irregular: eat, ate, ...
explanation: Eaten es el participio pasado de eat.

title: A starting point
prompt: Elige la palabra correcta: I have known my best friend ___ 2022.
options: since
for
yet
hint: 2022 señala el momento en que empezó la amistad.
explanation: Since indica un punto de inicio; for indica una duración.

title: The brave moment
prompt: Completa con el participio de be: I have ___ nervous before a performance.
hint: Be es irregular: be, was/were, ...
explanation: Been es el participio pasado de be.

title: The finished quest
prompt: Elige la oración correcta.
options: I have already finished my project.
I already have finish my project.
I have already finish my project.
answer: I have already finished my project.
hint: Already puede ir entre have y el participio.
explanation: Have already finished indica que la acción ya terminó y es relevante ahora.

title: A gift
prompt: Completa con el participio de make: We have ___ a gift for our teacher.
hint: Make es irregular: make, made, ...
explanation: Made es el participio pasado de make.

title: An adventure question
prompt: Elige la pregunta correcta.
options: Have you ever ridden a horse?
Have you ever rode a horse?
Has you ever ridden a horse?
answer: Have you ever ridden a horse?
hint: Ride, rode, ridden. Con you se usa have.
explanation: Ridden es el participio irregular que va después de have.

title: A photograph
prompt: Completa con el participio de take: I have ___ many photos of my family.
hint: Take es irregular: take, took, ...
explanation: Taken es el participio pasado de take.

title: The road
prompt: Completa con el participio de travel: My family has ___ across El Salvador.
hint: En inglés estadounidense se agrega -ed con una sola l.
explanation: Traveled es regular; también se acepta travelled del inglés británico.

title: A long friendship
prompt: Elige la palabra correcta: We have been friends ___ three years.
options: for
since
yet
hint: Three years indica cuánto tiempo ha durado la amistad.
explanation: For se usa para indicar duración.

title: A kind action
prompt: Completa con el participio de help: I have ___ a classmate with English.
hint: Help es regular: agrega -ed.
explanation: Helped es un participio regular.
